work.abstract_text: For Paul D. Hanna's OEIS A389472, revision 7 (2025), COMMENT 3, proved by Horace Dong (2026), we give an alternative proof of a(3n-1)=0 modulo 3 for every n>1, and integral-product extensions. The recurrence proof combines coefficient extraction with the least base-three digits of its binomial coefficients. An infinite-product identity relates this sequence to Hanna's A350432; it also proves the companion parity conjecture and the stated radius of convergence. A single product calculation also establishes the functional, inverse and radius identities of ten cross-referenced sequences, and identifies a missing series reversion in A273162's product formula.

work.title: Integral-product extensions and an alternative proof of Dong's (2026) theorem on OEIS A389472, revision 7, COMMENT 3
